text: dsh-vision-tool 是 DSH Web 的图片理解插件，注册 analyze_image 工具，并在文本模型无法接收图片时把粘贴图片存为附件、改写提示供工具分析。用户可传入附件或本地图片路径，询问图片内容并获得视觉模型的文字回答；本地文件支持常见图片格式和大小限制。默认连接 Kimi 视觉接口，需要配置 KIMI_CODE_API_KEY。

dsh-vision-tool adds image analysis to DSH Web. It registers analyze_image and rewrites pasted images as attachment references for text only models. Users can ask about an attachment or local image and get a vision model answer. The default Kimi endpoint requires KIMI_CODE_API_KEY.
想讓只能处理文字的 DSH 模型也能看懂我粘贴的图片。
能不能把截图交给视觉模型分析并回答我指定的问题？
我想让 DSH 读取本地图片文件并描述里面的内容。
让 DSH 在收到粘贴图片时自动保存附件，再调用图片分析工具。
How can I ask a text only DSH model to understand a pasted image?
I need a DSH tool that can inspect a local image and answer a question about it.
dsh-vision-tool 的功能「分析图片」：analyze_image 接收粘贴附件或本地路径，可附带问题，并把图片发送给视觉模型以返回文字回答。
dsh-vision-tool 的功能「转交粘贴图片」：当当前会话模型不支持图片输入时，插件把粘贴图片存为附件并将提示内容改写为携带附件引用的文本。
dsh-vision-tool 的功能「兼容模型图片输入」：若请求没有图片或模型能力支持/未知，提示路由会按原请求转发；改写流程无法处理时也回退转发。
DSH 不能直接看截图时，有办法让它识别图片里的文字吗？
我希望把聊天里贴的图变成附件引用，再让模型调用工具理解它。

dsh-vision-tool 提供工具 analyze_image：识别并分析图片：把图片发送给 Kimi 视觉模型处理并返回其文字回答。当前 DeepSeek 模型不支持直接图像输入，需要理解图片（截图、图表、扫描件、照片等）时，必须调用本工具。图片来源二选一：attachment（用户粘贴到对话中的图片，必须原样传入粘贴转发机制注入的完整引用 JSON，形如 {"attachmentId":"sha256:...","mediaType":"image/jpeg","bytes":N,"width":N,"height":N}，不要省略或改写任何字段）或 path（本地文件路径）。文件图片支持 png/jpg/jpeg/webp/gif 格式。

dsh-vision-tool README · dsh-vision-tool：Image routing for text-only models in [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) (DSH).

Text-only models (e.g. `deepseek-v4-flash`) cannot see images. This bundle gives
them eyes in two coordinated steps:

dsh-vision-tool README · dsh-vision-tool：1. **`vision-prompt`** — shadows `POST /api/session.prompt`. When the active
   session model does not support image input, pasted images are persisted as
   content-addressed attachments and rewritten in place into text prompts that
   carry the full attachment reference JSON. Any other request (no image, or a
   model that already supports images) is forwarded **unchanged**, with the
   official `/api` trust fence (DNS rebinding / cross-site defense) reimplemented.
2. **`vision-tool`** — registers a global `analyze_image` tool. The model calls
   it with the attachment reference (or a local file `path`); the tool routes
   the image to a vision model and returns its text answer.

dsh-vision-tool README · dsh-vision-tool：Verified end-to-end: paste an image → attachment persisted → model calls
`analyze_image` → vision model describes the image.

dsh-vision-tool README · Install：Requires the `dsh` CLI (see [package and install a plugin](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness/blob/master/docs/user/develop/basic/publish.md)).

```sh
dsh-vision-tool README · from npm (once published)：dsh plugin --profile <name> add dsh-vision-tool
dsh-vision-tool README · straight from a git host (pin a commit; no build step needed — pure ESM)：dsh plugin --profile <name> add github:<you>/dsh-vision-tool#<sha>
section: straight from a git host (pin a commit; no build step needed — pure ESM)

text:
dsh-vision-tool README · or from a local tarball：pnpm pack
dsh plugin --profile <name> add ./dsh-vision-tool-0.1.0.tgz
```

The bundle's `cordis.patch.yml` inserts two rows: `vision-tool` and
`vision-prompt`. Restart the profile afterwards:
sh
dsh --profile <name>
```

Verify the layer landed without booting:

```sh
dsh --profile <name> --dump-config   # look for the "# == dsh-vision-tool" layer
```

dsh-vision-tool README · Credential (required)：The tool resolves `KIMI_CODE_API_KEY` — from `$DSH_HOME/.credentials.yaml` or an
environment variable of the same name. Get the key from your
[Kimi Code](https://api.kimi.com/coding) subscription page (`sk-kimi-` prefix).

```yaml

dsh-vision-tool README · $DSH_HOME/.credentials.yaml：KIMI_CODE_API_KEY: sk-kimi-...
```

dsh-vision-tool README · Switching vision models：The defaults target `kimi-for-coding` at `https://api.kimi.com/coding/v1`.
Override the row in your profile's `cordis.patch.yml` (a patch replaces the
whole `config`, so restate every key you keep):

```yaml
- id: vision-tool
  name: dsh-vision-tool
  config:
    baseURL: https://api.kimi.com/coding/v1

dsh-vision-tool README · Switching vision models：> **Note:** `kimi-for-coding` only accepts `temperature: 1` (anything else is
> rejected with HTTP 400). The tool hard-codes `temperature: 1` as its default
> and is not configurable for this model. Other OpenAI-compatible vision
> endpoints generally work as long as they accept `temperature: 1`.

dsh-vision-tool README · Supported inputs：- `attachment` — full reference JSON injected by the paste-rewrite mechanism
  (`{"attachmentId":"sha256:...","mediaType":...,"bytes":N,"width":N,"height":N}`).
  Pass it verbatim; do not strip fields.
- `path` — local image file (absolute, or relative to the session cwd).
- Formats: `png` / `jpg` / `jpeg` / `webp` / `gif`. Local files up to
  `maxImageBytes` (default 20 MB). Attachments are bounded by the harness
  attachment store limits.

dsh-vision-tool README · Security：- `vision-prompt` reimplements the official `/api` trust fence: loopback /
  `trustedHosts` host check, `sec-fetch-site` and `Origin` checks.
- Request bodies are capped at 160 MB (413 otherwise), matching the harness
  http-bridge default.
- **Any failure degrades to passthrough** — the original request is forwarded
  unchanged, never swallowed or mangled.
- The tool only reads the attachment you reference and your configured
  credential; it never stores prompt or image content beyond the attachment
  store the harness itself maintains.

dsh-vision-tool README · Diagnostics：Both plugins append to `$DSH_HOME/vision-trace.log`:

```
handle: rewrite result = REWRITTEN
vision-tool: execute: resolve KIMI_CODE_API_KEY -> source=file len=72
```
